Impact is the value of consequence: what an action does to everything around it.
The 50 note drops one event onto a calm lattice. Dots swell at each crest and are pushed outward, weaker with
distance, never quite zero. The zero of the number is the point of impact, so the numeral itself is the cause.
Dot radius follows a damped cosine of distance from the impact point E.
Four pale discs centred on E; each ring where two discs meet is a flat multiply ink.
E sits in the counter of the zero. The numeral is the stone, the lattice the water.
Contour rings at D = n · 120 pass through every crest: the wave made visible.
Beyond 640 px the lattice has shrunk to nothing: consequences thin out.
One event E lands on a
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE
